summary: Develop climate-risk, retrofit, green lease, and disclosure skills for property portfolios. Build an investor-ready roadmap with TrainingCred.
lede: Real estate portfolio decarbonisation training helps investment professionals link property emissions and climate risks to asset decisions. It is for property investment, portfolio, asset-strategy, and sustainability professionals who need to establish emissions baselines, assess transition and physical risks, and prioritize retrofit and resilience actions. Exercises cover retrofit economics, capital planning, and climate disclosure controls.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who influence property investment, portfolio allocation, asset strategy, sustainability performance, or climate-risk reporting. It suits experienced practitioners who can evaluate investment information and now need to connect real estate finance with emissions, resilience, and disclosure decisions. A real estate portfolio manager will find direct application in asset prioritisation, while an investment analyst can use the methods to strengthen underwriting and scenario analysis.
prerequisites: You should have professional experience in real estate investment, asset management, portfolio management, ESG, sustainability, infrastructure investment, or property finance. Familiarity with property financial models, asset-level operating data, and investment committee papers will help you gain the most from the exercises. No coding or programming is required. The course teaches AI-assisted analysis, scenario interpretation, and dashboard workflows at an operational application level, not at technical engineering or software-development level.
